_note: Terminology policy for every Peaklab driver localisation, in one place. The point is cross-project consistency: a customer who buys an AULA keyboard and a KYSONA mouse from the same shop must not meet two different Mongolian words for the same control. Edit this file, not the individual mn.json files, when the policy changes. Linted by driver/tools/qa/lint_glossary.py.
_severity: keep_english and avoid are errors - they are precise. require is a warning: Mongolian phrasing legitimately varies, and the check is only applied to short labels.

terms.note: key = товчлуур. товч on its own means 'button/brief' and reads wrong on a keyboard. Suppressed when the same English string also says 'button', because товч IS the right word for a mouse button or an [Apply] button and many sentences contain both.
lighting = гэрэлтүүлэг as a standalone menu label, but the genitive of the shorter noun гэрэл (гэрлийн горим, гэрлийн өнгө) is normal Mongolian and is accepted.

_suffix_note: Mongolian is agglutinative, so an 'avoid' stem must not be matched as a bare substring: товч is a prefix of товчлуур. A token counts as the avoided word only when stripping one of these suffixes leaves exactly the stem, and the token is not itself the preferred word.
